Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: mg_06509_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Read input: mg_06509_combined.v · Open raw
module mg_06509 (input wire RST,input wire CLK_RX,input wire MKD_RX,input wire DATA_RX,output wire WRITE, FRAME_START,output wire [15:0] DATA);
reg [15:0] mkd_sr; 
 always@(posedge CLK_RX) 
  mkd_sr[15:0] <= {mkd_sr[14:0], MKD_RX}; 
 reg [15:0] data_sr; 
 always@(posedge CLK_RX) 
  data_sr[15:0] <= {DATA_RX, data_sr[15:1]}; 
 assign FRAME_START = (mkd_sr[15:12] == 4'b1111); 
 reg [15:0] data_cnt; 
 always@(posedge CLK_RX) 
  if(RST) 
  data_cnt <= 16'hffff; 
  else if(FRAME_START) 
  data_cnt <= 0; 
  else if(data_cnt != 16'hffff) 
  data_cnt <= data_cnt + 1; 
 reg [15:0] data_len; 
 always@(posedge CLK_RX) 
  if(RST) 
  data_len <= 0; 
  else if(data_cnt==31) 
  data_len <= data_sr; 
 assign WRITE = FRAME_START | data_cnt == 15 | data_cnt == 31 | ((data_cnt + 1) % 16 == 0 && data_cnt / 16 < data_len + 3); 
 assign DATA = data_sr; 
 endmodule
